label: Controls for the LIVING_2-to-LIVING_1 route at the Dei Filius root, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit two-being interpretations, checked by unfolding
meaning: Nonvacuity: STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES and the restricted sense bridge are jointly satisfiable with a living pure act. Sense mixing fails without the bridge: a pure act can have life at some time (LIVING_2) and not LIVING_1, so STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES alone does not give the living conjunct. The time-indexed premise is needed: with no life at any time the bridge holds and a pure act does not live. The restriction matters: the restricted bridge can hold where the unrestricted one fails. The new route does not presuppose the old intellect-gives-life bridge. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; they show where each premise is needed, not that it is false or doubtful.
